paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由（thought）以帮助预测后续文本 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。方法包含并行理由生成、混合预测头以及基于 REINFORCE 的理由优化三个步骤 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 继续预训练，发现零样本 GSM8K 从 5.9% 提升到 10.9%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 提升到 47.2%，且无需在这些任务上微调 [S1.p3]。作者认为这标志着语言模型向更通用、可扩展的推理学习迈出了一步 [S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心整理的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，STaR 等方法依赖特定任务或预定义任务集，限制了理由的规模和泛化性 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。因此，作者希望让语言模型从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断后续文本的理由 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus

method.text: Quiet-STaR 在每对观测 token 之间引入辅助的理由变量，目标是让模型生成能帮助预测后续文本的中间思考 [S3.p1]。方法分三步：并行理由生成（think）、混合思考前后预测（talk）、用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成（learn）[S4.SS1.p1]。并行生成通过缓存前向传播并拼接对角注意力掩码，使所有 token 的理由可以并行生成 [S4.SS2.p3]。作者还引入可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> 元 token，并用非短视的教师强制损失预测多个后续 token [S4.SS4.SSS1.p1][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence
Quiet-STaR operates with three main steps (Figure 1): 1. Parallel rationale generation (think, Subsection 4.2)
we cache each forward pass and concatenate a diagonal attention mask to the previous attention mask
The <| startofthought |> and <| endofthought |> tokens serve as learned meta-tokens that control the model’s rationale generation.
we use the parallel attention mask to compute the log probabilities of the true next tokens, applying teacher forcing

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，该语料技术网页密度较高；作者也在 C4 上评估 [S5.p2]。下游评估使用 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本直接推理能力 [S5.SS1.p1]。C4 评估使用 16 个 thought token 和 4 个 true token ahead，其余设置相同 [S5.SS1.p2]。此外还进行了链式思考实验，使用零样本提示“Let’s think step by step.”，在 128 个 GSM8K 测试样本上评估 [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K
for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup
we used a zero-shot prompt (“Let’s think step by step.”) without in-context examples
as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且性能随理由 token 数量增加而持续提升 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。作者发现思考对困难 token 的提升不成比例地大，大多数 token 不受影响 [S5.SS2.p1][A7.F7]。在链式思考实验中，8 样本多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin
there is a disproportionate improvement on more difficult tokens
The distribution is skewed, with most tokens unaffected, while a small fraction of hard tokens see substantial improvements from the thoughts.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR

limitations.text: 作者承认，为解决问题所做的简化之一是尚未验证这些技术是否适用于从零开始训练的模型，且目前只应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 带来显著的计算开销，在生成每个额外 token 前需要生成大量 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，作者指出无法保证模型表达的理由忠实反映其内部处理，也没有防止有害或有偏推理模式的保障 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness)
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful
